paesi.titolo: Tolls in Portugal with a rental car (2026): how to pay
paesi.come: Toll barriers on some motorways, electronic-only gantries (no booths) on others
paesi.prezzo_breve: Varies by gantry; €0.32 fee per gantry if you pay afterwards
paesi.noleggio_breve: By law the rental company must fit a toll device; ask for the toll service
paesi.risposta: many motorways in Portugal have electronic tolls only, with no toll booths, and rental companies must fit each car with a toll device and subscribe to a toll payment system; you can ask for the toll service when you rent the car.

citazioni.x: Toll barriers where vehicles must stop. These include lanes for manual payment (collect a ticket as you enter the highway and pay the toll for your trip when you exit) and electronic lanes exclusively for customers with active payment systems.
This system consists of gateways mounted on highways that detect vehicles passing through, there being no need for physical toll booths or for vehicles to stop.
A panel near each gateway shows the toll fees to be paid.
If you use these roads with a foreign-registered vehicle, you must have an activated means of payment.

Under Decree-Law No. 84-C/2022 of 9 December, companies renting vehicles without drivers on a rent-a-car and rent-a-cargo basis must equip each vehicle in their fleet with on-board equipment and subscribe to a toll payment system.

Many companies already have vehicles equipped with electronic devices, and customers can, if they wish, contract the service when renting the vehicle for direct debit of tolls. The conditions for the provision of the service must be checked with the Rent-a-Car company that has the contract with the respective collection entity (Via Verde Portugal).

In the case of a vehicle with a Portuguese registration number, and if the customer does not opt to use an electronic device and/or the Rent-a-Car company does not offer any toll payment service, the tolls can be paid later at CTT/Payshop. Please note that it may not be possible to fully match the billing period with the vehicle rental contract period.

In the case of a vehicle with a foreign registration number, and if the customer does not opt to use an electronic device and/ or the Rent-a-Car company does not offer any toll payment service, the customer must subscribe to one of the available payment systems (more information here).
After your journey, you have 15 business days to make the payment.
In addition to the toll charges, you will pay €0.32 for each passage, up to a maximum of €2.56 per payment.
Under Portuguese law, post-payment is only available for vehicles with Portuguese registration plates.

EasyToll allows automatic toll payment by associating a bank card (Visa, Mastercard or Maestro) to the vehicle registration number. The tolls are debited directly from the card account, with an additional cost of €0.32 per trip. Registration is valid for 30 days and applies to all national motorways.

The administrative offences provided for in this law are punishable by a fine of at least five times the amount of the respective toll charge, but never less than €25, and a maximum amount corresponding to twice the minimum amount of the fine, subject to the maximum limits provided for in the General Tax Offences Regime.

paesi.titolo: Tolls in France with a rental car (2026): how to pay
paesi.come: Toll barriers (card, cash, tag); free-flow gantries on some new motorways such as the A79
paesi.noleggio_breve: Not mentioned by the operators: ask the rental company
paesi.risposta: on motorways with toll barriers you pay at the barrier by toll tag, bank card or cash, while on free-flow motorways such as the A79 there are no barriers and, without a tag or an online registration, you have 72 hours to pay online.
paesi.nota: This page quotes APRR and ALIAE (A79). We could not read the websites of the French motorway association and of some other operators from our server on 30 October 2026. The APRR pages are in French: our English translation is under each quote.

citazioni.x: Le paiement s’opère de manière traditionnelle (télépéage, carte bancaire, espèces) pour l’ouverture des barrières de sortie.
Avec l’entrée sans ticket, le conducteur doit toujours transiter par une barrière de péage à la sortie de l’autoroute pour payer son trajet.
En flux libre, la sortie – tout comme l’entrée – se fait sans arrêt, sans ticket et sans barrière.
The A79 is a new generation motorway between Sazeret and Digoin. This motorway offers a free-flow toll system.
6 gates over 88 kilometres make it possible to identify the license plate and type of vehicle and thus automatically create an invoice.
Le parcours est automatiquement réglé si l’usager est muni d’un badge télépéage ou s’il s’est inscrit gratuitement en ligne. Sinon, il a 72 h pour régler son péage sur Internet.
Depuis juin 2024, il est également possible de régler son péage en flux libre en espèces ou par carte, dans le réseau bar-tabac-presse agréé Nirio, une solution de paiement du groupe FDJ.
Toutes les nouvelles autoroutes construites en France seront dotées du système de péage en flux libre.
Vous recevrez un avis de paiement accompagné d’une indemnité transactionnelle de 10€.
Si vous ne réglez pas dans les 15 jours suivant l’envoi de cet avis, cette indemnité passe à 90€, conformément à la Loi d’Orientation des Mobilités de 2019.

traduzioni.barriera: Payment is made the traditional way (toll tag, bank card, cash) to open the exit barriers.
traduzioni.senza_ticket: With ticketless entry, the driver still has to pass a toll barrier at the motorway exit to pay for the trip.
traduzioni.flusso: With free flow, the exit, like the entry, has no stop, no ticket and no barrier.
traduzioni.72h: The trip is paid automatically if the driver has a toll tag or has registered online for free. Otherwise, they have 72 hours to pay the toll online.
traduzioni.nirio: Since June 2024 you can also pay a free-flow toll in cash or by card at approved Nirio bar-tobacco-newsagent shops, a payment service of the FDJ group.
traduzioni.nuove: All new motorways built in France will have free-flow tolling.
traduzioni.10euro: You will receive a payment notice with a €10 settlement charge.
traduzioni.90euro: If you do not pay within 15 days of the notice being sent, the charge rises to €90, under the 2019 Mobility Orientation Law.

prezzi.voce: Free-flow toll not paid within 72 hours (A79, from the second time): settlement charge
prezzi.prova: Vous recevrez un avis de paiement accompagné d’une indemnité transactionnelle de 10€.

prezzi.voce: Settlement charge if still unpaid 15 days after the notice
prezzi.prova: Si vous ne réglez pas dans les 15 jours suivant l’envoi de cet avis, cette indemnité passe à 90€

paesi.noleggio_breve: Not mentioned by ASFINAG: check the plate with the official validity query
paesi.risposta: cars up to 3.5 tonnes need a valid vignette on Austrian motorways and expressways; the digital vignette for a car costs €9.60 for 1 day, €12.80 for 10 days, €32.00 for 2 months and €106.80 for the 2026 annual vignette, and some tunnels and Alpine passes charge an extra section toll.

citazioni.x: On Austria's motorways and expressways subject to tolls, vehicles up to and including 3.5 t require a valid vignette.
The vignette is a time-based toll for almost all motorways and expressways.
For certain tunnels and Alpine crossings (e.g., Brenner, Tauern, Karawanken), an additional section toll is charged.
Sales of the digital vignette for 2027 will start in early November 2026.
Buy the vignette before entering the toll network.

If the Digital Vignette is purchased via distance selling (e.g., as a private individual in the ASFINAG Mautshop or via the ASFINAG app), it is valid at the earliest from the 18th day after the online purchase. 1-day and 10-day vignettes are excluded — the waiting period does not apply to them.
Without a valid vignette, you risk a replacement toll or a fine of up to €3,000.
You can check whether a valid digital vignette exists for a vehicle license plate number via the validity query.

paesi.titolo: Tolls in Croatia with a rental car (2026): new system from March 2027
paesi.come: Toll plazas until 28 February 2027; from 1 March 2027, no toll plazas: ENC device or number plate recognition
paesi.noleggio_breve: Not mentioned by HAC or the new law: ask the rental company
paesi.risposta: until 28 February 2027 Croatian motorways have toll plazas: you take a ticket at the entry and pay at the exit by distance, in cash, by card (Diners, Mastercard, Maestro, Visa) or with an ENC device. From 1 March 2027 the Toll Collection Act brings in tolls without toll plazas or stopping: a car pays with an ENC device or by automatic number plate recognition, after its plate and a valid means of payment are registered in the system.
paesi.nota: This page quotes Hrvatske autoceste (HAC), which runs most Croatian motorways, its Crolibertas project site and the Toll Collection Act (Zakon o naplati cestarine) as published in the Official Gazette (Narodne novine). The law is in Croatian: our English translation is under each quote.

citazioni.x: The use of motorways and tolled structures under the competence of Hrvatske Autoceste d.o.o. implies the obligation of the user to pay a toll fee that is calculated based on the travelled distance between two toll location points and according to the vehicle category.

At the toll collection points (toll plazas) the toll is paid either in cash, ETC or with cards Diners, Mastercard, Maestro, Visa, INA card and the card of MOLGROUP which are indicated as acceptable as the means of payment at the toll location.

The users of electronic toll collection (ETC device – „ENC“) do not collect a toll ticket at the entry plaza; they pass through a dedicated lane and are liable to pay with the serviceable on board unit.
Double amount of toll for the longest route and for the relevant category of vehicles from the point of exit for the travelled motorway route is charged to users if:
they appear at the toll plaza exit without a recording on the transit medium
The maximum time one is allowed to stay on a motorway is up to 24 hours.
The ETC device is 15,00 €

paesi.chi: the motorway operator Hrvatske autoceste (HAC) and Croatia's Toll Collection Act

cambio.titolo: From 1 March 2027 (by law): tolls without toll plazas
frasi: Until 28 February 2027: toll plazas, as described by HAC below (ticket at the entry, payment at the exit).
From 1 March 2027: the articles of the Toll Collection Act on the new electronic toll system come into force. For cars the law allows an ENC device or automatic number plate recognition.

To use the motorway, the vehicle must first be registered in the system with its number plate and a valid means of payment (and the ENC device, if you use one): online, in a mobile app, in dedicated quick-registration lanes, at operators' sales offices or at partner sales points.
Using the motorway without registering costs the toll plus a statutory penalty of €120, under the same law.
HAC's Crolibertas site says that the new system will be fully applied from 1 March 2027 and that testing will continue until it is fully implemented: check it before you travel.

traduzioni.hr_stupanje: This Act enters into force on the eighth day after its publication in the Official Gazette (Narodne novine), except for the provisions of Article 14, Article 15(1) to (5), Articles 16 to 22, Article 23(1) to (7), Articles 24 to 27, Article 28(1) to (15), Articles 29 to 31, Article 32(1), (2) and (3), Articles 33 to 37, Article 38(1) to (9), Article 39(1) to (6), Article 40, Article 41(1) to (7), Article 42(1) to (6), Article 43, Article 44(1) to (9), Articles 45 and 46, Article 47(1), (2) and (3), Articles 48 and 49 and Articles 52 to 57, which enter into force on 1 March 2027.
traduzioni.hr_laka: (2) For light vehicles, microwave technology at a frequency of 5.8 GHz with the use of an ENC device, or automatic number plate recognition technology, is used.
traduzioni.hr_prijava: (2) To join the ESNC (the electronic toll system), the following must be registered in the ESNC: – under the APRP model (number plate recognition), the vehicle's number plate data and a valid means of payment – under the ENC model, the vehicle's number plate data, the serial number or barcode of the ENC device and a valid means of payment.
traduzioni.hr_gdje: (3) Registration in the ESNC can be done at the following points: – through the single national web sales point for registration in the ESNC – through mobile apps for registration in the ESNC, other digital services and the online banking of credit institutions – in dedicated lanes for quick registration in the ESNC – in the sales offices of the toll operators – at the sales points of third parties that have an agency contract with the toll operators.
traduzioni.hr_obveza: (1) The user must: – before and during the use of a motorway or a tolled structure with a light vehicle, make sure the vehicle is registered in the ESNC, in line with Article 16(1) and (7) of this Act, unless registration in the ESNC is not available
traduzioni.hr_penal: (9) The statutory penalty referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article is €120.00.
traduzioni.hr_tvrtka: (2) For a vehicle used to carry out the business of a legal person, a sole trader or a self-employed person, the obligation in paragraph 1, indents 1 and 2, of this Article must be met by the owner of the vehicle or by the person entitled to use the vehicle under a leasing or similar contract.
traduzioni.hr_vozac: (3) If the owner of the vehicle or the person entitled to use the vehicle under a leasing or similar contract does not meet the obligation in paragraph 2 of this Article, the driver must make sure that the vehicle referred to in paragraph 2 is registered in the ESNC.
traduzioni.hr_solidarno: (11) The following are jointly liable with the driver for the toll compensation and the statutory penalty referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article: – the owner of the vehicle, except in the case referred to in Article 6(3) of this Act – the person entitled to use the vehicle under a leasing or similar contract – the user of the ENC device.
traduzioni.hr_bez: (1) A driver who uses a motorway or a tolled structure without being registered in the ESNC in line with Article 16 of this Act must pay the toll operator the toll compensation, as a benefit obtained without legal basis, and a special charge (statutory penalty) for using the motorway or tolled structure without registration (hereinafter: statutory penalty), in the amount set in paragraph 9 of this Article.
